parseado.cita: Which board members have responsibility for organizational safety--as opposed to conventional health and safety at work concerns? ... Is information relating to organizational safety discussed at all regular board meetings--or their high-level equivalent?
parseado.razon: El paso reproduce dos preguntas que el libro plantea al gestor. 'Junta directiva' y 'reuniones regulares de alto nivel' corresponden a 'board members' y 'regular board meetings--or their high-level equivalent'. Omite 'todas' y la distinción con la seguridad laboral convencional. Son diferencias de detalle que no invierten el sentido. 'Honestamente' concuerda con L5272.
